_schema.purpose: Derived join over domains.json x curriculum_tree.json x standards_spine.json. Answers: which domains feed a branch, which branches are domain-starved, and which uncovered skills sit in a compelling domain.
_schema.domain_starved: true if a branch has fewer than 6 of the 40 domains feeding it, OR no HIGH-priority domain feeds it. This is about whether the SPINE reaches the branch.
_schema.case_starved: true if fewer than 10 of the 56 existing corpus cases sit in the branch's domains. This is about whether the CORPUS reaches the branch, and it is the real authoring signal.
_schema.orphan_uncovered_skills: spine skills with n==0 that no domain lists as a signature skill — still genuinely unreachable and the residual authoring risk
